components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only filled control; every interactive moment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 13.5px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: #7b83eb; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), transform 60ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8d94f0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: 500 13.5px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; background: #141517; color: #f7f8f8; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1f2124; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Void-black field with strong hairline border.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 400 13.5px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f7f8f8; background: #08090a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; outline: none; min-width: 0; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7075; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #7b83eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(123,131,235,0.14); }

components.name: Room Pill
components.description: Status readout: connection dot + room code in mono.
components.css: .ds-room-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #141517; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4cc38a; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(76,195,138,0.5); } .ds-code { font: 500 12px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #f7f8f8; }

components.name: Live Chip
components.description: Green pulse while the room is playing.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 11.5px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #d7f5e5; border: 1px solid rgba(76,195,138,0.4); background: rgba(76,195,138,0.15); } .ds-live i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4cc38a; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #4cc38a; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.name: Tab Button
components.description: Quiet pill tab; active gains a raised surface.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { font: 500 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #9aa0a6; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #f7f8f8; } .ds-tab.active { color: #f7f8f8; background: #141517; }

components.name: Chat Bubble (own)
components.description: Raised bubble, indigo tint and broken corner on the sender side.
components.css: .ds-bubble { display: inline-block; font: 400 13.5px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f7f8f8; background: rgba(123,131,235,0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(123,131,235,0.28); border-radius: 12px 4px 12px 12px; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Transparent row that raises on hover with reveal actions.
components.html: Video title
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-row:hover { background: #141517; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-thumb { width: 92px; aspect-ratio: 16/9; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-title { flex: 1; font: 500 13px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f7f8f8; } .ds-act { opacity: 0; color: #9aa0a6; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-row:hover .ds-act { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: PlaySync's interface is a precision instrument in layered neutral black. Everything is quiet until it matters: hairline borders separate surfaces instead of boxes-in-boxes, one indigo accent marks every interactive moment, and the only chromatic statements are semantic (green = the room is playing, red = errors). The reference bar is Linear/Raycast — craft you feel in spacing, hover states and micro-transitions, not in decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Layered neutral blacks, four surface steps plus a hover step.
One accent (indigo) at ≤10% coverage of any screen.
Hairline white-alpha borders (7–12% white) instead of solid grays.
150ms ease-out on every state change; nothing bounces, nothing glows.
Inter everywhere; monospace reserved strictly for codes and timecodes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only where a user can act or where their own message lives. If a surface is not interactive, it has no accent.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green means playing; red means error. Neither is used decoratively.

rules.name: The Mono Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine data (codes, clocks); it never styles buttons or prose.

rules.name: The Layered Black Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a surface step first; shadows only accompany a real floating element (card, overlay), never a flat list row.

dos: Do use Inter 13–14px for all UI text; −0.006em body tracking.
Do keep borders as white-alpha hairlines (0.07–0.12) on every raised surface.
Do reserve mono (IBM Plex Mono) for room codes and timecodes.
Do transition states at 150ms ease-out; scale the seek thumb on hover.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent or colored decoration; green/red are semantic only.
Don't use metaphor instruments, retro faces, or skin props — elegance is spacing and order, not costume.
Don't nest cards; rows live on hairlines or hover surfaces.
Don't use pills for buttons — pills are status readouts only.
